name: Patmos Aktis, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa
positioning: Beachfront resort overlooking Grikos Bay on the Greek island of Patmos, with private-pool suites, a beachfront house and the ANASA Wellness & Spa
best_for: Travelers who want a beach stay on Grikos Bay with a private-pool suite
Families or groups who want a beachfront house or a two-bedroom maisonette
Visitors to the Monastery of St. John and the Cave of the Apocalypse

facts.text: The resort overlooks Grikos Bay on the island of Patmos.
Kalikatsou Rock reflects its shape on the waters of Grikos Bay.
The beach offers sunbeds, beach towels and umbrellas, with shade under trees.
Aegean Suites with balcony offer sea views from the private balcony.
The one- and two-bedroom maisonettes have a terrace and a private pool.
ANASA Wellness & Spa is named for the Greek word Anasa, meaning breath.
The resort has an outdoor lap pool and an indoor pool at the ANASA Wellness & Spa.
Nearby is the Monastery of St. John, a UNESCO Heritage Site with Byzantine architecture and panoramic views.
Nearby is the Cave of the Apocalypse, where St. John received Revelation, a sacred site for pilgrims.
Plefsis Tavern is a waterfront taverna facing Grikos Bay, serving Greek recipes inspired mainly by the Dodecanese or local cuisine.
Barolo Patmos is an Italian restaurant in an open-air space overlooking the sunset.

highlights.text: The Aegean Beach Front Suite with Private Pool has its own pool and terrace with views of the island's landmarks.
The Fisherman's House is a beachfront house on Grikos Bay suited to families or groups.
The beach in front of the resort is on the southeast side of Patmos in Grikos Bay, framed by rock formations.
The spa is on the lower level and uses 'beyond organic' Ila treatments, with an indoor pool, hammam, rasul cabin, sauna and private treatment rooms.
Boat excursions to hidden beaches and nearby islands can be arranged through the Luxury Concierge service.

considerations.text: The rooms do not have a work space.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
WhataHotel notes limited nightlife and entertainment options on a quiet island.
